## Claude Liam Signal — how it got here

Each note below is a step that actually happened, with the measurement that
caused it. Read left to right. Nothing here executes — this canvas is the map.

### 1 · The panel
**v4 → v14**

One HTML file, no build step. Scans the top 100 by volume, streams every one of
them on 5m and 15m through a single websocket, and re-runs the strategy the
moment a candle closes.

Nine rooms, each with a heartbeat. A supervisor checks all of them every second
and repairs what has gone quiet.

### 2 · The strategy
**channel + order block + pullback**

Channel fitted, blocks and unfilled gaps and touch-ranked levels marked. Signal
fires when a candle closes back out of the block. Entry that close, stop the far
side, targets at prior swings paying ≥ 1.8R.

A second pullback is the textbook trap but often never comes — a context score
decides whether to take the first, and says why.

### 3 · Four defects, found by measuring

**Look-ahead** — entry was the box edge, but the signal only exists after price
closes past it. Fill is now that close.

**Targets too close** — nearest prior swing paid 0.74R. Now ≥ 1.8R or skip.

**Score predicted nothing** — quality ≥70 scored the same expectancy as <70. It
gates nothing now.

**Stale setups** — expectancy fell monotonically with bars since the break.
0–10 bars +0.149R · 40–70 −0.255R · 120+ −0.352R.

### 4 · Decide on expectancy
**not on a score**

p = probability the first target lands before the stop, from a logistic model
over the setup's evidence.

Take it when **p·R − (1−p)** clears the threshold.

Weights start at **zero** and are earned from real closed trades. Hand-picked
values measured AUC 0.44 — worse than no model at all.

### 5 · Two desks

**Practice** — live tape, real prices, no money, no signal. Gates loose on
purpose: any structure with a real entry, stop and target. This is where the
sample comes from.

**Signal** — strict. Before one goes out the supervisor asks the learning room
about *that coin, that direction, situations like this*. Enough negative history
vetoes it and says so.

### 6 · One change per cycle

Every two hours: settled trades split by setup age, pullbacks, timeframe,
direction, R:R, evidence and regime. Each slice bootstrapped.

Grade the previous change against trades closed since → keep or revert → then at
most **one** new change. A reverted change is quarantined three days; leaving it
eligible produced an oscillation, not a search.

**A finding is only acted on once its interval clears zero.**

### 7 · Where the compute went

GitHub runners, not the laptop:
· cycle every 2h
· parameter search nightly — 144 configurations, fitted on 200 markets, judged
  on 200 it never saw
· Pages deploy every 6h, enabling Pages through the API so no setting is touched
  by hand

The search earned the two current parameters: freshness 15→10 bars, decisive
break 0.50→0.35 ATR. **+0.211R → +0.255R.**

### 8 · Where it goes now

**Telegram** — signals with entry, stop, both targets, R:R, confidence, the
block, the channel, dominance, and what similar setups did. Plus outcomes and
the five-minute room report. A failed send queues and retries.

**Notion** — one row per cycle, comparable over time.
**Drive** — the archive.
**Gmail** — morning digest, as a draft.
**n8n** — moves all of it without a session open.

### Next · toward 90%

Accuracy rises by **growing the practice sample**, not by tightening the signal
gate until nothing fires. Zero signals is not 100%.

The learning room needs thousands of settled live trades before its veto means
anything. Until then it says so instead of pretending.

One open blocker: if Binance is geo-blocked from Hamid's side, no live candle
ever reaches the panel and none of this accumulates. A VPN is what fixes it.

### Rules that do not change

· Measure before changing anything · report expectancy, not win rate
· Bootstrap every slice · sample in the thousands, not hundreds
· Fit and judge on different markets · one change per cycle, graded next cycle
· Say which source a number came from, every time
· Every number has a script in `tests/` that reproduces it
